Row.Text: Adds a Dam building to each age. Build it on a river tile, navigable or not; once it is finished, floods on that river no longer pillage the improvements, buildings and districts of the settlements along it. The cost is the valley: the Dam holds the water back and the floodplains dry out, so the land along the river gives up that Food for good. A river takes one Dam of each age, so an old Dam can be joined by a newer one. Unlocked by Irrigation, Machinery and Electricity.

Holds back the river it stands on. Must be placed on a river tile, navigable or not. A river takes one Dam of each age. When it is finished, floods on this river no longer pillage Improvements, Buildings or Districts in any [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] along it. Floods still come and are still reported; they simply do no damage. The valley dries out behind it: this river loses its [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_FLOODPLAINS_TOOLTIP]Floodplains[/TIP] and the [icon:YIELD_FOOD] Food they carry.
Settlements along this river are not pillaged by its floods. The river loses its Floodplains. One of each age per river.
Raised by a Dam on this settlement's river. Improvements, Buildings and Districts in this [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] are not pillaged by floods.
A Dam must be built on a river tile.
This river already has a Dam from this age.
